notes.title: 🛠️ New Playtest Build Live!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Catizens, The newest CitaDrill playtest build just dropped on Steam!. We’ve packed in fresh art, slicker UI, louder sounds, smarter enemies, and more toys to justify tax dollars on. Already in the playtest? Hit download. Not in yet? Now’s the time, join our discord for a free playtest steam key![/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454835/254ed012f1de2a72fd2cc310a5643457f50062d7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454835/411cd5464960d2cdfc49fdcad96c81197853f240.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454835/8057080c0ffc9f1b5f9b7065ec93746b970b610e.png"][/img][/carousel][olist][*][p] Visual Glow-Up [/p][list][*][p]Buildings have their full art + animation pass, sourced directly from the cave version of Ikea.,[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay and Building UI has been rebuilt as per C.A.T's wishes. They say its to help you steer, we think it helps them track catizen browser history.,[/p][/*][*][p]VFX for Quick Actions are designed, with a few testers dropped in. Many (many) more on the way!,[/p][/*][*][p]New level objects sprinkled in for variety (and a little extra story spice).[/p][/*][*][p] Sounds That Pop[/p][/*][*][p]New SFX across menus, UI and status effects.,[/p][/*][*][p]Still in progress, but the world’s feeling a lot more alive, and a whole lot noisier.,[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][/*][*][p]Enemies[/p][list][*][p]Amoeba boss got a brain upgrade. Watch your step.,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p]Narrative[/p][list][*][p]Crew now pipes up mid-run with our new Narrative Bark System. Cassandra cannot be muted.,[/p][/*][*][p]New narrative moments that'll help you get closer to solving the whole existential "why am I here" thing.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][/*][*][p]Modules, Upgrades & Expansion[/p][list][*][p]Loads of new modules to try, fresh off the drill-city factory.,[/p][/*][*][p]Every module now has its own upgrades for more interesting choices.,[/p][/*][*][p]Your city grows as you play, with roads and houses reimagined as power nodes + lines. Catizens now perch on powerlines like birds.,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p]Bug Squash Buffet[/p][list][*][p]Many, many bugs gone. Some are surely lurking, so keep the reports coming.,[/p][/*][*][p]We’re a big step closer to the game we’re aiming for, and your feedback’s shaping the path. Feel free to join our discord so you can be part of the conversation, and help steer where we drill next.,[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Until the next update! ~ The CitaDrill Team[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: The Playtest is Live!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454835/fe32d3ad2a7b87ad6f688fcea7738c99bd50fe84.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hey Catizens! [/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to finally announce the first-ever public playtest for CitaDrill, our in-development roguelike city-builder about drilling into the unknown with a team of eccentric Captains, mysterious buildings, and plenty of strategic (and occasionally silly) decision-making. This build includes: [/p][list][*][p]The first fully playable loop,[/p][/*][*][p]A mix of early-game buildings, enemies, and systems to explore,[/p][/*][*][p]New UI prototypes and early narrative content,[/p][/*][/list][p]It's still early days and you’ll see some rough edges and placeholder content — but we’re really eager to gather your thoughts on how it feels to build, explore, and survive in the mines. [/p][p][/p][p]Want to join the playtest? We’re distributing Steam keys directly through our Discord server. It’s the best place to grab a key, report bugs, and chat directly with the devs. You’ll find everything you need in the #playtest-keys channel once you’re in. Your feedback matters. We’re building this game with you, and your input at this stage means the world. Whether it’s balancing suggestions, UI complaints, or Captain opinions, we want to hear it all. Thanks so much for your support. We hope you enjoy the build. See you in the deeps. [/p][p][/p][p]The Studio Moka Team[/p]

notes.title: CitaDrill's First Ever Newsletter!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454835/36f1cf03137655a35f12f15b99d13ce7716f7208.png[/img]

[b]Hello fellow Catizens![/b]
First off, we at Studio Moka want to say a massive [b]thank you[/b] for wishlisting CitaDrill! Your support means the world to us and we’re thrilled to have you onboard as we dig deeper into development.

[b]Monthly Updates Incoming[/b]
We’re excited to announce that starting this month, we’ll be posting monthly game progress updates here on Steam! These will cover new features, design insights, and behind-the-scenes details on the world of CitaDrill. So without further ado…

[b]What We’re Working On[/b]
Hey there! As the producer at Studio Moka, I’m commandeering this post for a moment to talk about our recent progress, which is something I’ll continue doing from now on!
Over the last few weeks, we’ve been hard at work fleshing out our mid-game content with new Projects, Buildings, Upgrades, Modules and Narrative Encounters. Our Narrative Designer has created a fresh new story outline that has us pumped to flesh out the world with deeper lore, and interesting and consistently bizarre new characters you’ll be able to encounter over the course of the game. We’ve been adjusting the way lighting works in the deep!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454835/79b22f64a7022b34547522585e8d94df08eb8e03.gif[/img]

For the next month, we’re doubling down on a complete UI overhaul, adding new Drill Captains, integrating brand new music for each of our biomes (which are also getting facelifts themselves), and settling on a direction for that big bad Final Boss™. The members of our small studio are super excited by all these new endeavours, and we can’t wait to post next month’s update to show where we’re at on all that. Stay tuned!

[b]Join Our Discord[/b]
Want the chance to help shape CitaDrill, or simply crave a space to chat about city-builders and roguelikes (and cats???)? Join our official Discord server! You’d gain access to weekly updates, be able to directly chat with the devs, and have many opportunities to give feedback as we continue to refine the game.

[url=https://discord.gg/hbZ7rmVqMQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454835/9661974a174ca7bf42fbe303a7b40ffb3f40a4e1.png[/img][/url]

[b]Thank You Demo Nights![/b]
We had a blast showcasing CitaDrill at Demo Nights 2025, and we’re incredibly grateful to Loto Quebec for having us! If you missed it, you can check out our interview here: 

[previewyoutube=mneM21AylTE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]See You at La Console qui Console[/b]
Finally, CitaDrill will be attending [b]La Console qui Console[/b] in Sherbrooke Quebec, this March 29-30! If you’re in the area, drop by to chat with the team, try out the game, and get a first-hand look at what we’ve been working on!

[url=https://www.laconsolequiconsole.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454835/97be9cf19eb69947027e4a03a516e7257061dbfc.png[/img][/url]

Thanks again for your support, and we hope to see you in the Discord soon <3
--
The CitaDrill Team
